messages:
sana: Thanks everyone - quick follow-up from the infra section of today's all-hands. A few people asked for concrete APAC GPU timing + autoscale details so I wanted to capture answers here and any action items.

ryan: First q - when can teams expect H100 capacity in ap-northeast? The slide said Q2 but we heard provisioning risks.

meredith: Short answer: phased. We have contractual ok for H100 racks in ap-northeast arriving mid-May, carrier scheduling puts them into our DCs by ~end-May. Full capacity (meaning >90% of target) expected by mid-June after burn-in and QA.

alina: Is that dependent on the new CUDA patch? we hit perf variance on last batch.

meredith: Good catch. We rolled a targeted kernel update yesterday that addresses the perf delta for long-context workloads; not blocking arrival. We will still run a quick perf sweep during bring-up - won't block customers but we will mark early nodes as "experimental" until validated.

mike: Autoscale behavior question: will APAC use the same pre-warm burst pools or a different policy? we saw cold starts on a few endpoints last week.

meredith: APAC will mirror the EU model but with two tweaks: 1) a small warm pool (20% of baseline) pre-allocated during regional business hours to avoid cold starts for high-SLO routes, and 2) a separate burst-tier using spot-equivalent instances for non-SLA traffic. Teams can opt-in per-route.

ryan: Can we get the explicit switchover rules? like latency threshold or queue depth?

meredith: Yes - short version: if 95th latency exceeds 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes AND queue depth > 50 reqs for 30s, controller triggers warm-pool expansion. Burst-tier triggers when warm-pool expansion is exhausted and predicted 5-min demand > 2x baseline. I'll paste the exact rule set in the follow-up doc.

alina: Any change to pricing/quotes for Dedicated customers in APAC because of H100 rollout?

meredith: No immediate pricing changes. For Dedicated renewals we're offering an H100 add-on pilot for select customers (reduced commit, higher priority placement). Sales/Finance will publish details by next Friday.

ops-bot: ACTION CREATED: infra/region-apac - "APAC H100 rollout QA & autoscale rules" assigned to @ryan, due 2026-05-12.

sana: Thanks - super helpful. Meredith, can you drop the bring-up checklist link? and ryan, please own the doc with the explicit rules + route opt-in steps.

meredith: Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/apac-h100-rollout (internal) - checklist, perf key results, and the experimental node tag conventions. I'll also add the exact SLO thresholds.

ryan: Will do. I'll post the doc and tag teams (platform, dedicated-cust, eng-sre) when it's ready. Expected by 2026-04-28.

mike: One last note - can we please make the warm pool size configurable per-route? some routes are chatty but very low-cost.

meredith: Yes, config will be per-route in console + API. Default is regional policy but can be pinned at route-level.

sana: Awesome. If nobody objects I'll summarize this and send a short follow-up to the all-hands thread with links. :rocket:

alina: thanks! :heart:
thread_text: This thread captures the Q&A follow-up on APAC GPU timeline and autoscale plans. Root message was the all-hands follow-up, replies include infra/ops clarifications and an action created by ops-bot.
